description: Install a chosen LangChain integration package (pip) into the LangChain RAG plugin venv. Only the literal pip command runs, after you approve it. The package name comes from the plugin's bundled list.

steps.description: pip install the selected LangChain package into ~/.mobilessh/langchain/venv (creates the venv if the RAG plugin has not yet).
steps.run: set -e; VENV="$HOME/.mobilessh/langchain/venv"; test -x "$VENV/bin/pip" || python3 -m venv "$VENV"; "$VENV/bin/pip" install "{{package}}"

uninstall.description: Best-effort pip-uninstall the packages this plugin can install (from the shared venv).
uninstall.run: V="$HOME/.mobilessh/langchain/venv"; test -x "$V/bin/pip" && "$V/bin/pip" uninstall -y langchain-ollama langchain-chroma langchain-qdrant langchain-community langchain-huggingface langchain-text-splitters langchain-unstructured langchain-postgres langchain-mongodb langchain-elasticsearch langchain-google-community langchain-experimental || true
